slice: F12 full two-dimensional edge-preserving bilateral denoise

semantics.alpha: Center alpha and zero-alpha hidden RGB copied exactly
semantics.inert: Zero radius, colorSigma or amount and disabled values bypass native resampling and SVG rasterization

independentWasmReference.method: Direct combined-exponential normalized 2D equations independent of WASM lookup tables

verification.native50MP: 10000x5000 source, 1024x128 native crop, exact original SHA-256/dimensions before and after project reopening

quality.scope: Deterministic synthetic RGB8 fine-noise fixtures, not general photographic quality

limits: Controlled noisy RGB8 fixtures, not evidence of camera-specific photo quality, RAW development, scene-linear/HDR or trained noise models
Larger neighborhoods, tolerances and strength can soften texture/detail; real-world quality review remains open
Functional regression passes do not establish sustained latency, 60fps, physical tablet/GPU/display or whole-process peak memory
Existing filter-mask regression telemetry includes long tasks above 50 ms; it is retained without attributing them to this new filter
